# Phase 5 single-doc byte-identity baseline.

# Captured 2026-04-24 against commit 7881178e (pre-Phase-5 refactor).
# Each line: "<relative-path-from-doc-dir> <sha256>"
#
# After Phase 5's scoped-artifact refactor, these hashes MUST remain
# unchanged. See `claude-notes/plans/2026-04-24-websites-phase-5.md`
# Decision 10.
#
# To re-capture (if intentional changes to default theme / template
# land), render `doc.qmd` and run:
#   shasum -a 256 doc.html doc_files/styles.css
#
# Re-captured 2026-04-29 (bd-mgoh): doc.html hash updated because
# `#quarto-content` now carries the `quarto-container` class for parity
# with Q1 (no SCSS rule selects on it; it's a defensive addition that
# anchors the website-sidebar layout fix in template.rs).
#
# Re-captured 2026-04-30 (bd-bsut): doc_files/styles.css hash updated
# because the page-nav layout SCSS (`.page-navigation { display: flex; …
# }`, `.nav-page` family, `@media print { .nav-page { display: none } }`)
# was ported from Q1 into `_bootstrap-rules.scss`. doc.html hash is
# unchanged: the new selectors don't match anything in a single-doc
# render's body, and `<head>` is unaffected (no <link> changes for
# single-doc).
#
# Re-captured 2026-04-30 (bd-bsut, sidebar-link parity follow-up):
# doc_files/styles.css hash updated again because the sidebar-link
# styling SCSS (`.sidebar-navigation a { color: inherit }`,
# `.sidebar-title > a`, `.sidebar-item`, `.sidebar-section`,
# `div.sidebar-item-container { color/hover/active/disabled }`, …) was
# ported from Q1 into `_bootstrap-rules.scss` next to the page-nav
# block. doc.html hash unchanged for the same reason as before — none
# of the `.sidebar-*` selectors match anything in a single-doc body.
#
# Re-captured 2026-04-30 (bd-bsut, .sidebar-title font-sizing): added
# the missing `.sidebar-title { font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1.6rem;
# … }` rule from Q1's `quarto-nav.scss:281` so the website's site-title
# at the top of the sidebar reads as a heading instead of inheriting
# the small sidebar-link font-size.
#
# Re-captured 2026-04-30 (bd-k8y0, sidebar appearance polish): added
# `.quarto-container { min-height: calc(100vh - 132px) }` (so a docked
# sidebar's vertical separator extends to the bottom of the viewport
# on short pages) and `#quarto-sidebar > * { padding-right: 1em }` (so
# toggle dongles aren't flush against the sidebar's right border).
# Both ported from Q1's `quarto-nav.scss` (lines 53-55 and 623-628).
# doc.html hash unchanged: neither selector matches anything in a
# single-doc body (no `.quarto-container` and no `#quarto-sidebar`),
# but they appear in the compiled CSS so the `styles.css` hash shifts.
#
# Re-captured 2026-05-01 (bd-f5yi follow-up, c8dcbcf6): added
# `body.floating .sidebar.sidebar-navigation { display: none }` under
# `media-breakpoint-down(lg)` so a floating sidebar disappears in the
# 768–991 px range instead of collapsing to a 26-px ghost column.
# doc.html hash unchanged: the new selector doesn't match anything in
# a single-doc body (no `body.floating`), but it appears in the
# compiled CSS so the `styles.css` hash shifts.
#
# Re-captured 2026-05-04 (bd-4eyf): doc.html hash updated because
# Bootstrap-themed renders now ship a `<script
# src="doc_files/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>` in `<head>`
# (vendored Bootstrap 5.3.1 bundle, with Popper). doc_files/styles.css
# hash is unchanged: the new feature is JS-only and does not touch
# the SCSS pipeline. A new file `doc_files/bootstrap.bundle.min.js`
# is also written; we deliberately do not list it here because the
# baseline only tracks files that previously existed.
#
# Re-captured 2026-05-19 (bd-j73yw): doc_files/styles.css hash updated
# because Phase 1 of bd-1tl09 (code-block decorations) ported the
# filename-header SCSS from Q1's `_quarto-rules-code-filename.scss`
# into `_bootstrap-rules.scss` (`.code-with-filename`,
# `.code-with-filename-file`, `.quarto-dark` overrides). doc.html hash
# unchanged: the new selectors don't match anything in the
# single-doc fixture's body (no code block with a `filename`
# attribute), but they appear in the compiled CSS so the
# `styles.css` hash shifts.
#
# Re-captured 2026-05-19 (bd-j1trh): doc.html hash updated because
# Phase 2 of bd-1tl09 added ClipboardJsStage, which ships
# `js:clipboard` (the vendored clipboard.js library) as a
# Project-scoped artifact whenever `code-copy` isn't explicitly false.
# The new `<script src="doc_files/clipboard.min.js"></script>` lands
# in `<head>` next to the existing Bootstrap-bundle script tag. The
# fixture has no code blocks so the body is unchanged; only the
# `<head>` script list shifts. doc_files/styles.css hash is
# unchanged (Commit 2 doesn't touch SCSS — that's Commit 3). A new
# file `doc_files/clipboard.min.js` is also written; we deliberately
# do not list it here because the baseline only tracks files that
# previously existed (same convention as bootstrap.bundle.min.js).
#
# Re-captured 2026-05-19 (bd-j1trh, Commit 3): both hashes updated.
# doc.html shifts because ClipboardJsStage now also ships
# `js:code-copy-init` (a small init handler), adding a third
# `<script src="doc_files/code-copy-init.js"></script>` tag in
# `<head>` after the alphabetic-sort step.
# doc_files/styles.css shifts because the copy-button SCSS rules
# were ported from Q1's `_quarto-rules-copy-code.scss` +
# `_quarto-variables-copy-code.scss` into `_bootstrap-rules.scss`
# (`$code-copy-selector`, `$btn-code-copy-color`, `.code-copy-button`,
# the SVG-icon background-image rules, hover and checked states),
# plus the `div.code-copy-outer-scaffold { position: relative }`
# rule from Q1's `_quarto-rules.scss:285` that makes the absolutely-
# positioned button anchor to the scaffold instead of the viewport
# (caught during browser e2e). The new selectors don't match
# anything in the single-doc fixture's body (no code blocks), but
# they appear in the compiled CSS so the hash shifts. A new file
# `doc_files/code-copy-init.js` is also written; not listed here
# per the same convention as `bootstrap.bundle.min.js` /
# `clipboard.min.js`.
